'''J Street''' was a transit boulevard on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was the sight of the chase involving [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]]. The street was similar to many streets of Coruscant, with packed speeder traffic running through the levels.

==History==
During a chase, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] pursued the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] to this street. After running along the top of a structure, Cryar released a weighted-plate and used it to descend to the news platforms below. As Cryar jumped from one platform to the next, Tano jumped down from the platform to follow. Cryar then cut the repulsorlift supports causing the platforms to collapse. Tano managed to keep up with all of the platforms until the final one when she jumped too late. As a result, J Street traffic was diverted all around the collapsing platforms while Tano clung to the face of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] on an announcement holofeed. As a result, Cryar managed to gain higher ground. Meanwhile, Cryar's partner [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]] had almost been caught by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and Marcy was traveling in her [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] in order to escape the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|police]]. Cryar, who was scaling a pipe at the time, told her to meet her at the corner of J Street. Tano soon arrived and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to tilt the pipe to a horizontal angle. While Tano tried to climb out to Cryar, who repeatedly jumped on the pipe, again diverting traffic on J Street. Soon afterwards, before Tano could apprehend her, Cryar jumped into the waiting Marcy's speeder and escaped to the train station.

==Behind the scenes==
As [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] is chasing [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], they jump over numerous floating advertising boards that feature [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] writing. One such board reads "SODA;", another reads "STAR TOURS GLEE ANSELM CALL 1-800-555-6576 NOW!". The text under [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] reads "KUAT DRIVE YARDS AWARD" before being cut off.

Despite the fact that one of the floating ads Ahsoka jumps on involves Palpatine making a speech and that the speech is included in the quotes from the episode guide<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode211.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>, neither the character nor [[Ian Abercrombie]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] usual voice actor, appear in the credits.
